name: CktEvo
description: Register-Transfer Level (RTL) coding is an iterative, repository-scale process in which Power, Performance, and Area (PPA) emerge from interactions across many files and the downstream toolchain. While large language models (LLMs) have recently been applied to hardware design, most efforts focus on generation or debugging from natural-language prompts, where ambiguity and hallucinations necessitate expert review. A separate line of work begins from formal inputs, yet typically optimizes high-level synthesis or isolated modules and remains decoupled from cross-file dependencies.
